[[King/Legends|King]] '''Sethun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] that was the leader of the [[Planet/Legends|Planet]] [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] and the husband of the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nyscha]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Together with his wife, he was captured on the [[Waypoint Station Three]] by [[Augin Blaesus]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Kyrus]], in an attempt to force his planet into submission to the Sith Empire. Their plot was foiled when the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] arrived, and swiftly dispatched both Sith.

==Behind the scenes==
Sethun is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
